data.desc: J-Long Group Limited is an established distributor in Hong Kong of reflective and non-reflective garment trims including, among others, heat transfers, fabrics, woven labels and tapes, sewing badges, piping, zipper pullers and drawcords. The Company offers a wide range of services to cater to customers' needs in reflective and non-reflective garment trims, including market trend analysis, product design and development and production and quality control.
